slots.title: Trump to throw spotlight on overseas crypto abuses at White House event
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The president is hosting a cybercrime event that will highlight U.S. authorities' efforts to crack down on crypto scams run by foreign criminal organizations.

slots.title: Crypto Long & Short: Why real-world assets need fixed-rate loans onchain
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Real-world assets already back the largest stablecoins, yet borrowing against them onchain still runs through variable-rate pools. Peter Gaffney of O2O Capital Partners explains why fixed-rate, fixed-term lending is the missing piece, and how a 5% shift in Sky and Ethena reserves

slots.title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

slots.title: Foursquare co-founder says equity holders saw no returns from the company’s acquisition
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Foursquare raised $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, but its equity holders saw no returns from its final acquisition.

slots.title: How a16z-backed DATA is rethinking its blockchain strategy after $30 million Sui deal
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The startup is retiring its own blockchain and moving to Sui with a $30 million investment as it narrows its focus to AI training data.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Why centralized exchanges refuse to list legacy crypto tokens without explicit SEC immunity
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Vault12 raised $17.45 million selling VGT in 2018 and says it met or dropped every promise, yet the token has never traded on a centralized exchange.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
